Thick_Mycelial_Trunk_Arms.description: Bulging with thick, resilient mycelium, the Thick_Mycelial_Trunk_Arms are formidable fungal appendages that grant their bearer immense physical strength, though at the cost of agility, enabling them to execute powerful knockdown attacks and regenerate wounds with eerie speed.

Hardened_Shelf_Fungus_Blade_Arms.description: Emerging from the twisted limbs of ancient, corrupted trees, the Hardened Shelf Fungus Blade Arms are gnarled and jagged, their surfaces as tough as iron yet still pulsating with dark fungal life, granting their wielder an imposing strength and natural armor, while their razor-sharp edges prowl for any opportunity to inflict grievous, bleeding wounds.

Toxic_Spore_Venting_Puffball_Arms.description: Emerging from the writhing fungal mass of the creature, these arms are not merely extensions of flesh but living conduits of noxious spores, their tips puffing out clouds of acrid toxins that can poison even the hardiest of foes, while also granting the bearer a measure of resistance to such noxious vapors.

Extendable_Cordyceps_Slammer_Arms.description: Bristling with razor-sharp fungal tendrils, the Extendable Cordyceps Slammer Arms grant their wielder unparalleled agility and reach, allowing them to grapple and sunder with ease, as the parasitic growths extend and retract with preternatural speed and flexibility.

Slime_Mold_Amorphous_Pseudopods.description: Amorphous pseudopods, resembling writhing fungal tendrils, allow the entity to move with unsettling fluidity and grip onto surfaces with bone-crushing strength, enhancing its agility and stealth while enabling it to traverse any terrain without penalty.

Bioluminescent_Fairy_Wand_Arms.description: These ethereal appendages are not mere arms, but delicate, fungal tendrils that pulse with a soft, otherworldly light, granting their bearer heightened magical perception and the ability to both cast light and reflect hostile spells.

Decaying_Rot_Wood_Branch_Arms.description: These twisted, fungal arms are a grotesque amalgamation of decayed wood and pulsating black spores, capable of rending foes with unnatural strength while instilling fear and resisting the forces that would knock them back.

Crystalline_Underdark_Fungus_Claw_Arms.description: Emerging from the shadowy depths of the Underdark, the crystalline fungus claws are arms of twisted elegance, their translucent, gem-like tendrils dripping with the essence of darkness, capable of slashing through enemies with devastating precision and leaving trails of festering wounds.

Vibrant_Amanita_Club_Arms.description: Emerging from the pallid flesh of the host, these ethereal arms are adorned with vibrant amanita mushrooms, pulsating with a life of their own, granting the bearer a chaotic allure and the ability to unleash a cloud of debilitating poison.

Ghost_Fungus_Spectral_Limbs.description: Emerging from the shadowy undergrowth, spectral limbs of ghostly fungus stretch forth, their semi-transparent, fungal tendrils blending into the mist as they skitter silently across the ground, granting their wielder a chilling aura of stealth and an eerie wisdom beyond the grave.
